actions.what: Write art-direction.json: run craft direction init, then give every choice a reason from the client's world.
Pick the display face from the client's world (signage, packaging, the trade's lettering), record why in art-direction.json, and keep it unique across the estate.
actions.why: Reflex font (reflex-font, gen 1); Second-wave reflex font (reflex-font-2, gen 2), in source and on the page; Italic serif display (italic-serif-display, gen 2)

actions.what: Remove it. Spend the signature moment on something the visitor came for.
actions.why: Intro cinematic (intro-cinematic, gen 2); Scrolling marquee (marquee, gen 2); Reveal on every section (reveal-everywhere, gen 1)

actions.what: Follow the hero with the thing only this business has: the work, the place, the person. Put proof where a doubt arises.
actions.why: Hero straight into a trust strip (hero-then-proof, gen 1)

actions.what: Use a full stop, a comma, or a colon. Two sentences are clearer than one sentence with a dash in it.
Cut the phrase and start with the point it was introducing. 'Seamless booking' becomes 'Book in three taps'.
Name the mechanism instead. 'Empower your team' becomes 'Your team can publish without us'.
actions.why: A plainer word exists (plainer-word), 4 places, first at .claude/skills/copy-check/SKILL.md:65

actions.what: Say the positive claim and drop the contrast.
Say what they get: 'We reply within a day and only about your enquiry'.
actions.why: 'No X, no Y' list (no-x-no-y), 1 place, first at app/cookies/page.tsx:30

actions.what: Keep the one that lands hardest and cut the rest. 'What is genuinely excellent' reads better as 'what is excellent'.
actions.why: Review-tier phrase (review-phrase), 2 places, first at app/terms/page.tsx:42
